newsitem.title: USA: Crown Casino to exit casino industry.
newsitem.headline: Crown Casino to exit casino industry.

text.p: Crown Casino Corp said on Tuesday it has decided to leave the casino gaming industry and seek an acquisition or merger in another, still undetermined, field.
The company said the board of directors reached the decision after discussions with its investment bankers, Jefferies and Co.
Crown Casino also said it would not complete the planned acquisition of the Mississippi Belle II riverboat casino located in Clinton, Iowa.

Crown said there were several factors influencing its decision, including the limited growth prospects for casino gaming, increasing competitive pressures, the low valuation small and mid-cap gaming companies receive in the market, and the risk of increasing federal and state regulation and taxes.
Crown said it is exploring a number of possible acquisitions and merger options but could not predict if an agreement may be reached.

"Generally, we are seeking to acquire or merge with a company or companies that have a history of revenue and cash flow growth and that have excellent growth prospects in industry sectors that are viewed favorably in the public market," the company said.
